description: OpenCompass is an LLM evaluation platform, supporting a wide range of models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek, etc, across 100+ datasets covering knowledge, reasoning, coding, science, language, long-context, and safety.
